description: SNAP API: skip Browser Integrity Check only after a confirmed BIC false positive
expression: (http.host eq "api.snaptvnow.com" and ((http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/admin"}) or (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "POST"} and http.request.uri.path eq "/player_api.php") or (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/health" "/stream" "/gnula-media"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/live/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/movie/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/series/")))))
